name: TAMOVAC 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TAMOVAC 10 TABLET

TAMOVAC 10 TABLET contains Tamoxifen which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-estrogen agents. It is used for breast cancer. This medicine is also used for reproductive health in women caused by a failure to produce and release eggs. Breast cancer is a disease in which cells in the breast grow out of control. There are different kinds of breast cancer. The kind of breast cancer depends on which cells in the breast turn into cancer.

Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating a healthy diet, healthy sleep habits and managing your weight. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain breast examinations to understand your existing condition. TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with a history of blood clots (including family).

TAMOVAC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of hereditary angioedema. TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Inform your doctor before taking TAMOVAC 10 TABLET if you are breastfeeding. TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. The most common side effects of taking TAMOVAC 10 TABLET are nausea, fluid retention, skin rash, hot flushes, tiredness and anemia. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a long time.
uses: Used for breast cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAMOVAC 10 TABLET
Used for breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How TAMOVAC 10 TABLET Works

TAMOVAC 10 TABLET works by binding to estrogen receptors and blocking the effects of estrogen (natural female hormone) in the breast tissue. This slows down the growth and multiplication of breast cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use TAMOVAC 10 TABLET

Take TAMOVAC 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Reddish non-elevated, target-like or circular patches on the trunk, often with central blisters, skin peeling, ulcers of mouth, throat, nose, genitals and eyes (Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis)
Irregular periods, especially if associated with heavier bleeding as this could be a warning sign for a certain type of cancer affecting the lining of womb (endometrial cancer)
Feeling of discomfort in the lower tummy (pelvis)

warnings.details: TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor immediately if you think you may have become pregnant.
Inform your doctor if you are breastfeeding before taking TAMOVAC 10 TABLET.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience tiredness after taking TAMOVAC 10 TABLET.
Do not take TAMOVAC 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Tamoxifen or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Consult your doctor before taking.

Others

TAMOVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are taking management for reproductive health
Have or had blood clots in the past  
Have family history of blood clots
Have illness which runs in the family that increases the risk of blood clots

Before taking TAMOVAC 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are to undergo planned surgery
Have a history of hereditary angioedema
Are intolerant to certain sugars (lactose)

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking, TAMOVAC 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Oral contraceptives
Hormone replacement therapy (HRT)
Antidepressants (Ex. paroxetine, fluoxetine)
Bupropion (used as antidepressant or aid smoking cessation)
Quinidine (used for cardiac arrhythmia)
Cincalet/cinacalcet (used for disorders of the parathyroid gland)
Blood thinning medicines such as warfarin 
Rifampicin (used for tuberculosis)
Medicines used for breast cancer (Ex. anastrozole, letrozole and exemestane)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAMOVAC 10 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are uncontrollable shaking of a part of the body, unsteadiness and dizziness.

name: Fertolet 2.5mg Tablet 5'S
introduction:
Introduction About FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET

FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.
uses: For breast cancer in postmenopausal women
As an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines (such as tamoxifen)
usesDetails:
Uses Of FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET

It is used:

For breast cancer in postmenopausal women
As an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines (such as tamoxifen)
mechanismOfAction:
How FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET Works

FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.
usageDetails:
How to use FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET

Take FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Urinary tract infection, increased frequency of urination
Inflammation of the mouth and lips (stomatitis)

FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, tired, drowsy or generally unwell after taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET to avoid unwanted reactions.
FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Letrozole.
FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have not gone through menopause

Before taking FERTOLET 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

A history of bone fractures or osteoporosis
Osteoporosis (weak bones) or joint inflammation

introduction:
Introduction About CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET

CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET contains Bicalutamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anti-androgens. It is used in the management of prostate cancer in adult male patients. Prostate cancer is a type of slow-growing cancer that occurs in the cells of the prostate gland (a small walnut-shaped gland that provides nourishment to sperm in males) that grows out of control and spreads to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer is characterized by symptoms such as troubled urination, blood in urine, the urge to urinate frequently at night, blood in semen, bone pain, losing weight without trying, pain while sitting, and erectile dysfunction. During management with CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET, your doctor may perform blood tests to check for any changes to your blood.

Avoid direct exposure to excessive sunlight or UV light while you are taking CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET. Before taking CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems or diabetes. CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women, including pregnant women or mothers who are breast-feeding their babies.

CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (less than 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET are skin rash, breast swelling or tenderness, weakness, loss of appetite, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET Works

CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET inhibits cell growth and manages the spread of cancer cells from the prostate gland to other parts of the body by selectively blocking proteins responsible for the growth and development of the prostate gland (androgen receptors), which reduces the effect of androgen (the male sex hormone) in the prostate gland.
usageDetails:
How to use CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET

Take CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water, and do not chew or crush it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET management for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CALUTIDE 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET

ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ALTRAZ 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET

LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETROHOPE 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET

LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

How LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET Works

LETOVAL 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPRODEX

LUPRODEX contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) agonist. It is used to manage endometriosis, relieving pain and reducing endometriotic lesions. It is also used for preoperative hematologic improvement in women having fibroids (abnormal growth in uterus) induced anaemia for whom hormonal suppression is considered necessary for three months.

Endometriosis is a chronic disease in which a tissue like the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, resulting in pain and/or infertility. It is characterized by symptoms such as pain during periods, pelvic pain, pain associated with sexual intercourse, painful urination, fatigue, depression, bloating and nausea.

Do not receive LUPRODEX if you are allergic to Leuprolide, GnRH, or GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney impairment, or undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding.

Inform your doctor if you are chronic alcohol or tobacco user or have strong family history of osteoporosis or chronic use of medicines.

LUPRODEX is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary. It is not recommended for use in premenarcheal children and postmenopausal women. Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of LUPRODEX are hot flashes/sweating, general pain, headache, gastrointestinal disorders, swelling due to water retention, nausea, vomiting, reduced libido, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

It works by blocking the secretion of gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH) following an initial stimulation, resulting in suppression of ovarian and testicular steroidogenesis (process of synthesis of steroid hormones), thereby relieving the symptoms associated with increased levels of sex hormones.

Introduction About BICATERO 50MG TABLET

BICATERO 50MG TABLET contains Bicalutamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anti-androgens. It is used in the management of prostate cancer in adult male patients. Prostate cancer is a type of slow-growing cancer that occurs in the cells of the prostate gland (a small walnut-shaped gland that provides nourishment to sperm in males) that grows out of control and spreads to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer is characterized by symptoms such as troubled urination, blood in urine, the urge to urinate frequently at night, blood in semen, bone pain, losing weight without trying, pain while sitting, and erectile dysfunction. During management with BICATERO 50MG TABLET, your doctor may perform blood tests to check for any changes to your blood.

Avoid direct exposure to excessive sunlight or UV light while you are taking BICATERO 50MG TABLET. Before taking BICATERO 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems or diabetes. BICATERO 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women, including pregnant women or mothers who are breast-feeding their babies.

BICATERO 50MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (less than 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking BICATERO 50MG TABLET are skin rash, breast swelling or tenderness, weakness, loss of appetite, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET

MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET contains Megestrol which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestogens. MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET is used for hormone dependent cancer which includes breast and endometrial cancer in affected individuals. MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET is also used for reduced appetite and weight-loss in patients passing through an advanced stage of cancer/HIV. MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Megestrol.

Before taking MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thrombophlebitis (blood clot due to inflammatory process), intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), and/or severe liver problems. MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET is not generally recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MEGAHENZ 40MG TABLET are increase in appetite, shortness of breath, high blood pressure, hot flushes, nausea, vomiting, passing wind, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ANABREZ 1MG TABLET

ANABREZ 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ANABREZ 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ANABREZ 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ANABREZ 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ANABREZ 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ANABREZ 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To lower the levels of oestrogen in post-menopausal women

mechanismOfAction:
How ANABREZ 1MG TABLET Works

ANABREZ 1MG TABLET works by lowering the levels of a sex hormone called oestrogen in liver, fat, muscle, and breast cells by inhibiting the aromatase enzyme, which converts androgens into oestrogen (which stimulates the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast).

Take ANABREZ 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLLETRO 5 TABLET

FOLLETRO 5 TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking FOLLETRO 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking FOLLETRO 5 TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

FOLLETRO 5 TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking FOLLETRO 5 TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLLETRO 5 TABLET Works

FOLLETRO 5 TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

Introduction About ENDACE 40MG TABLET

ENDACE 40MG TABLET contains Megestrol which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestogens. ENDACE 40MG TABLET is used for hormone dependent cancer which includes breast and endometrial cancer in affected individuals. ENDACE 40MG TABLET is also used for reduced appetite and weight-loss in patients passing through an advanced stage of cancer/HIV. ENDACE 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Megestrol.

Before taking ENDACE 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thrombophlebitis (blood clot due to inflammatory process), intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), and/or severe liver problems. ENDACE 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. ENDACE 40MG TABLET is not generally recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ENDACE 40MG TABLET are increase in appetite, shortness of breath, high blood pressure, hot flushes, nausea, vomiting, passing wind, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET

FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking FEMITRAZ 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET

LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

LETPRO 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

Introduction About CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET

CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET contains Megestrol which belongs to the group of medicines called Progestogens. CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET is used for hormone dependent cancer which includes breast and endometrial cancer in affected individuals. CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET is also used for reduced appetite and weight-loss in patients passing through an advanced stage of cancer/HIV. CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Megestrol.

Before taking CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thrombophlebitis (blood clot due to inflammatory process), intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), and/or severe liver problems. CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET is not generally recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CRAVIHENZ 40 TABLET are increase in appetite, shortness of breath, high blood pressure, hot flushes, nausea, vomiting, passing wind, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About SAMLET 2.5 TABLET

SAMLET 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking SAMLET 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking SAMLET 2.5 TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

SAMLET 2.5 TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking SAMLET 2.5 TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SAMLET 2.5 TABLET Works

SAMLET 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

Introduction About LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET

LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETROVAC 2.5 TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET

ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET Works

ARIMIDEX 1MG TABLET works by lowering the levels of a sex hormone called oestrogen in liver, fat, muscle, and breast cells by inhibiting the aromatase enzyme, which converts androgens into oestrogen (which stimulates the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast).

introduction:
Introduction About ELINAL 1MG TABLET

ELINAL 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ELINAL 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ELINAL 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ELINAL 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ELINAL 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ELINAL 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To lower the levels of oestrogen in post-menopausal women

To lower the levels of oestrogen in post-menopausal women
mechanismOfAction:
How ELINAL 1MG TABLET Works

ELINAL 1MG TABLET works by lowering the levels of a sex hormone called oestrogen in liver, fat, muscle, and breast cells by inhibiting the aromatase enzyme, which converts androgens into oestrogen (which stimulates the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast).

Take ELINAL 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET

LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

LETROPRIME 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

introduction:
Introduction About CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET

CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET contains Bicalutamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anti-androgens. It is used in the management of prostate cancer in adult male patients. Prostate cancer is a type of slow-growing cancer that occurs in the cells of the prostate gland (a small walnut-shaped gland that provides nourishment to sperm in males) that grows out of control and spreads to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer is characterized by symptoms such as troubled urination, blood in urine, the urge to urinate frequently at night, blood in semen, bone pain, losing weight without trying, pain while sitting, and erectile dysfunction. During management with CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET, your doctor may perform blood tests to check for any changes to your blood.

Avoid direct exposure to excessive sunlight or UV light while you are taking CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET. Before taking CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or heart problems or diabetes. CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women, including pregnant women or mothers who are breast-feeding their babies.

CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (less than 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET are skin rash, breast swelling or tenderness, weakness, loss of appetite, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.
uses: To manage prostate cancer in adult male patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET
To manage prostate cancer in adult male patients
mechanismOfAction:
How CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET Works

CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET inhibits cell growth and manages the spread of cancer cells from the prostate gland to other parts of the body by selectively blocking proteins responsible for the growth and development of the prostate gland (androgen receptors), which reduces the effect of androgen (the male sex hormone) in the prostate gland.
usageDetails:

Take CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water, and do not chew or crush it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET management for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CALBIMIDE 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About BRELET 2.5MG TABLET

BRELET 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking BRELET 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking BRELET 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

BRELET 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking BRELET 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How BRELET 2.5MG TABLET Works

BRELET 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

How to use BRELET 2.5MG TABLET

Take BRELET 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Cytomid 250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CYTOMID 250MG TABLET

CYTOMID 250MG TABLET contains Flutamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-androgen agents. It is used for advanced prostatic cancer, which is a type of cancer that occurs in the gland cells of prostate gland (male reproductive organ). CYTOMID 250MG TABLET is also used after surgical castration in affected individuals.

Before taking CYTOMID 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are at a risk of developing osteoporosis (condition marked by brittle bones) or have a family history of osteoporosis, suffering from diabetes, any blood vessel condition, and/or have intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose.), heart problems (heart rhythm disorders), liver and kidney problems.

CYTOMID 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women as it is intended to be used only in men. It is also not recommended for use in children since it is indicated for use only in men. This medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CYTOMID 250MG TABLET are liver disease (hepatitis) which may cause nausea, vomiting, itching, dark coloured urine, pale stools, loss of appetite, yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes or abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsens.
uses: Used for advanced prostatic cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYTOMID 250MG TABLET
Used for advanced prostatic cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CYTOMID 250MG TABLET Works

CYTOMID 250MG TABLET works by binding to androgen receptors in prostate cancer cells which blocks synthesis of testosterone needed for cancer cells to grow resulting in its blockade of growth and spread of cancer to different parts of the body thus used for prostate cancer in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use CYTOMID 250MG TABLET

Take CYTOMID 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Letero 2.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LETERO 2.5MG TABLET

LETERO 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETERO 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETERO 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETERO 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETERO 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

How LETERO 2.5MG TABLET Works

LETERO 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

introduction:
Introduction About TAMODEX 20MG TABLET

TAMODEX 20MG TABLET contains Tamoxifen which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-estrogen agents. It is used for breast cancer. This medicine is also used for reproductive health in women caused by a failure to produce and release eggs. Breast cancer is a disease in which cells in the breast grow out of control. There are different kinds of breast cancer. The kind of breast cancer depends on which cells in the breast turn into cancer.

Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating a healthy diet, healthy sleep habits and managing your weight. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain breast examinations to understand your existing condition. TAMODEX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with a history of blood clots (including family).

TAMODEX 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of hereditary angioedema. TAMODEX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Inform your doctor before taking TAMODEX 20MG TABLET if you are breastfeeding. TAMODEX 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. The most common side effects of taking TAMODEX 20MG TABLET are nausea, fluid retention, skin rash, hot flushes, tiredness and anemia. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a long time.
uses: Used for breast cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAMODEX 20MG TABLET
Used for breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How TAMODEX 20MG TABLET Works

TAMODEX 20MG TABLET works by binding to estrogen receptors and blocking the effects of estrogen (natural female hormone) in the breast tissue. This slows down the growth and multiplication of breast cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use TAMODEX 20MG TABLET

Take TAMODEX 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Clomipure L 2.5mg Tablet 5'S
introduction:
Introduction About CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET

CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET Works

CLOMIPURE L 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

introduction:
Introduction About LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET

LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

How LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET Works

LETROZ 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

name: Encrpc 40mg Capsule 28'S
introduction:
Introduction About ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE

ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, clonazepam, phenytoin, primidone, and valproic acid)

Medicines used to manage stomach disorders (Ex. omeprazole)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ENCRPC 40MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The symptoms of an overdose are seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About XTANE 25MG TABLET

XTANE 25MG TABLET contains Exemestane which belongs to the group of medicines called Aromatase inhibitors. It is used for advanced breast cancer in post-menopausal women whose disease has progressed following Tamoxifen therapy. It is also used for hormone-dependent advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women when management with different hormonal drug management has not worked well enough.

Breast cancer is a disease in which cells in the breast grow out of control. There are different kinds of breast cancer. The kind of breast cancer depends on which cells in the breast turn into cancer. Breast cancer can begin in different parts of the breast.

Before taking XTANE 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problem, a history or are suffering from any condition which affects the strength of your bones. XTANE 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking XTANE 25MG TABLET are depression, headache, muscle, and joint pain, hair loss, and abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.
uses: Advanced breast cancer in post-menopausal women whose disease has progressed following Tamoxifen therapy
Hormone-dependent advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women when management with different hormonal drug management has not worked well enough

mechanismOfAction:
How XTANE 25MG TABLET Works

XTANE 25MG TABLET belongs to aromatase inhibitor which blocks the enzyme aromatase (found in the body's muscle, skin, breast and fat), which is used to convert androgens (hormones produced by the adrenal glands) into estrogen. In the absence of estrogen, tumors dependent on this hormone for growth will shrink. It works by reducing the amount of oestrogen made in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use XTANE 25MG TABLET

Take XTANE 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION

LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) agonist. It is used for palliative management (relieving symptoms and minimize the associated suffering) of advanced prostatic cancer.

Advanced prostatic cancer is the cancer (abnormal cell multiplication and differentiation) that originates in the prostate gland and spreads to the other parts of the body. It is characterized by the symptoms such as painful urination, decreased urine pressure, blood in the semen, bone pain, leg swelling, and weakness.

Do not receive LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Leuprolide and other GnRH, GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney failure, metastatic vertebral lesions, urinary tract obstruction, diabetes or if you have history of orchiectomy (surgical removal of testes) or have been managed with an LH-RH agonist analog previously also.

LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION are hot flashes, impotence, anaemia, bone pain, muscle pain, dizziness, light-headedness, general pain, headache, sleeplessness, sleep disorders, and shortness of breath. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
uses: Used for palliative management (relieving symptoms and minimize the associated suffering) of advanced prostatic cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION
Used for palliative management (relieving symptoms and minimize the associated suffering) of advanced prostatic cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION Works

LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION helps in palliative management of advanced prostatic cancer where leuprolide works by initial stimulation followed by blocking of secretion of gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH), resulting in suppression of production of ovarian and testicular hormones. This thus helps to relieve the symptoms associated with increased testosterone levels in advanced prostatic cancer.
usageDetails:
How to use LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION

LUPRIDE 1MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse subcutaneously (under the skin). Keep changing the site of injection periodically if taken for long term. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION

EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) agonist. It is used for palliative management (relieving symptoms and minimize the associated suffering) of advanced prostatic cancer.

Advanced prostatic cancer is the cancer (abnormal cell multiplication and differentiation) that originates in the prostate gland and spreads to the other parts of the body. It is characterized by the symptoms such as painful urination, decreased urine pressure, blood in the semen, bone pain, leg swelling, and weakness.

Do not receive EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Leuprolide and other GnRH, GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney failure, metastatic vertebral lesions, urinary tract obstruction, diabetes or if you have history of orchiectomy (surgical removal of testes) or have been managed with an LH-RH agonist analog previously also.

EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION are hot flashes, impotence, anaemia, bone pain, muscle pain, dizziness, light-headedness, general pain, headache, sleeplessness, sleep disorders, and shortness of breath. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION Works

EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION helps in palliative management of advanced prostatic cancer where leuprolide works by initial stimulation followed by blocking of secretion of gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH), resulting in suppression of production of ovarian and testicular hormones. This thus helps to relieve the symptoms associated with increased testosterone levels in advanced prostatic cancer.

EUROLIDE 1MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse subcutaneously (under the skin). Keep changing the site of injection periodically if taken for long term. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BDENZA 80 CAPSULE

BDENZA 80 CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking BDENZA 80 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). BDENZA 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. BDENZA 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking BDENZA 80 CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET

ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ONCOZOLE 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET

LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

LUTENON 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. introduction:
Introduction About LUPARD 11.25MG INJECTION(DEPOT)

LUPARD 11.25MG INJECTION(DEPOT) contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) Agonist. It is used to manage endometriosis, relieving pain and reducing endometriotic lesions. It is also used for preoperative hematologic improvement in women having fibroids (abnormal growth in uterus) induced anaemia for whom hormonal suppression is considered necessary for three months. It is also used in children to manage central precocious puberty (CPP).

Endometriosis is a chronic disease in which a tissue like the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, resulting in pain and/or infertility. It is characterized by symptoms such as pain during periods, pelvic pain, pain associated with sexual intercourse, painful urination, fatigue, depression, bloating and nausea.

Central precocious puberty (CPP) is the early onset of sexual characteristics in girls (generally earlier than 8 years) and boys (generally earlier than 9 years of age in boys) due to activation of pubertal pituitary gonadotropins. It may result in diminished adult height.

Do not receive LUPARD 11.25MG INJECTION(DEPOT) if you are allergic to Leuprolide acetate, GnRH or GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney impairment or undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding.

LUPARD 11.25MG INJECTION(DEPOT) is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) for endometriosis and fibroids.

introduction:
Introduction About ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET

ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET contains Anastrozole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer drugs. It works by lowering the levels of a female sex hormone called oestrogen (responsible for the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast) in women who have undergone menopause.

Along with the management, you might have to undergo some lifestyle changes, such as maintaining a healthy weight, exercising, and quitting alcohol. Prior to the management of ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET, your doctor might want you to take some diagnostic tests to better evaluate your condition.

Before taking ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, lactose intolerance, or osteoporosis (decreased strength of bones).

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, you should not take ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET without the consultation of your doctor.

ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution with elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET are hot flushes, weakness, pain, stiffness or inflammation in joints, nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To lower the levels of oestrogen in post-menopausal women

mechanismOfAction:
How ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET Works

ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET works by lowering the levels of a sex hormone called oestrogen in liver, fat, muscle, and breast cells by inhibiting the aromatase enzyme, which converts androgens into oestrogen (which stimulates the growth and proliferation of tumour cells in the breast).

Take ARMOTRAZ 1MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LEUREN 11.25MG INJECTION

LEUREN 11.25MG INJECTION contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) Agonist. It is used to manage endometriosis, relieving pain and reducing endometriotic lesions. It is also used for preoperative hematologic improvement in women having fibroids (abnormal growth in uterus) induced anaemia for whom hormonal suppression is considered necessary for three months. It is also used in children to manage central precocious puberty (CPP).

Endometriosis is a chronic disease in which a tissue like the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, resulting in pain and/or infertility. It is characterized by symptoms such as pain during periods, pelvic pain, pain associated with sexual intercourse, painful urination, fatigue, depression, bloating and nausea.

Central precocious puberty (CPP) is the early onset of sexual characteristics in girls (generally earlier than 8 years) and boys (generally earlier than 9 years of age in boys) due to activation of pubertal pituitary gonadotropins. It may result in diminished adult height.

Do not receive LEUREN 11.25MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Leuprolide acetate, GnRH or GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney impairment or undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding.

LEUREN 11.25MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) for endometriosis and fibroids.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years) for central precocious puberty (CPP). It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of LEUREN 11.25MG INJECTION are hot flashes, sweating, general pain, headache, gastrointestinal disorders, swelling due to water retention, nausea, vomiting, reduced libido and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

name: LETROSIS 2.5 Tablet 5's
introduction:
Introduction About LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET

LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.
uses: For breast cancer in postmenopausal women
As an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines (such as tamoxifen)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET

It is used:

For breast cancer in postmenopausal women
As an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines (such as tamoxifen)
mechanismOfAction:
How LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET Works

LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.
usageDetails:
How to use LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET

Take LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of blood clot (such as difficulty in breathing, fainting, rapid heart rate, chest pain, bluish skin discoloration, leg, or foot pain)
Tendon rupture causing bone pain, inflammation of the tendons
Severe fever, chills, or mouth ulcers due to infections
Swelling and redness along a vein which is tender painful when touched
Sudden onset of oppressive chest pain
Signs of a brain disorder or a stroke (weakness, paralysis, or numbness in any part of the body, loss of coordination, nausea, or difficulty in speaking or breathing)
Signs of allergic reactions (such as swelling of the face and throat)
Hepatitis (symptoms include loss of appetite, dark-colored urine, yellow skin and eyes, nausea)
Signs of serious skin reactions (such as skin rash, red skin, blistering and peeling of the skin, accompanied with fever)
Swelling of arms, hands, feet, ankles
Pain or burning sensation in the hands or wrist (carpal tunnel syndrome)
Impaired sensation of touch, tingling or numbness
Urinary tract infection, increased frequency of urination
Inflammation of the mouth and lips (stomatitis)

LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, tired, drowsy or generally unwell after taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET to avoid unwanted reactions.
LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET if you are allergic to Letrozole.
LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have not gone through menopause

Before taking LETROSIS 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

A history of bone fractures or osteoporosis
Osteoporosis (weak bones) or joint inflammation

introduction:
Introduction About LEUPO 11.25MG INJECTION

LEUPO 11.25MG INJECTION contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) Agonist. It is used to manage endometriosis, relieving pain and reducing endometriotic lesions. It is also used for preoperative hematologic improvement in women having fibroids (abnormal growth in uterus) induced anaemia for whom hormonal suppression is considered necessary for three months. It is also used in children to manage central precocious puberty (CPP).

Endometriosis is a chronic disease in which a tissue like the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, resulting in pain and/or infertility. It is characterized by symptoms such as pain during periods, pelvic pain, pain associated with sexual intercourse, painful urination, fatigue, depression, bloating and nausea.

Central precocious puberty (CPP) is the early onset of sexual characteristics in girls (generally earlier than 8 years) and boys (generally earlier than 9 years of age in boys) due to activation of pubertal pituitary gonadotropins. It may result in diminished adult height.

Do not receive LEUPO 11.25MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Leuprolide acetate, GnRH or GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney impairment or undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding.

LEUPO 11.25MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) for endometriosis and fibroids.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years) for central precocious puberty (CPP). It is not recommended for use in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of LEUPO 11.25MG INJECTION are hot flashes, sweating, general pain, headache, gastrointestinal disorders, swelling due to water retention, nausea, vomiting, reduced libido and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.
