name: Firmagon 80mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION

FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is used to manage adult patients with advanced hormone dependent prostate cancer. It contains Degarelix which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotrophin-releasing hormone antagonist or GnRH blocker. FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION works by blocking messages from a part of the brain called the hypothalamus that tells the pituitary gland to produce luteinising hormone. Luteinising hormone tells the testicles to produce testosterone. So degarelix stops the testicles making testosterone. Prostate cancer depends on testosterone to grow. Hormone therapy blocks or lowers the amount of testosterone in the body.

FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients have low bone density, glucose intolerance, diabetes mellitus, liver, kidney or cardiovascular diseases. FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION are hot flushes and inflammation around the injection site, dizziness, weight gain, headache, diarrhoea. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION.

FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION will be administered by a healthcare professional only. It is for subcutaneous administration only and is not to be administered intravenously. FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is for subcutaneous administration to the abdominal region only. As with other medicines administered by subcutaneous injection, the injection site should vary periodically. Injections should be given in areas of the abdomen that will not be exposed to pressure. (e.g., not close to waistband or belt nor close to the ribs. It should be reconstituted before use.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I stop my management with FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION suddenly?
faqs.answer: A: Patients who are receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION for a longer duration should not stop the management with FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION suddenly or without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will slowly reduce your dosage, to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

faqs.question: Q: What are the precautions need to be followed while receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients have low bone density, glucose intolerance, diabetes mellitus, liver, kidney or cardiovascular diseases.

faqs.question: Q: What are the methods of after reconstitution of FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: The reconstituted solution must be clear liquid free from any undissolved matter. Chemical and physical in-use stability of the reconstituted solution has been demonstrated for 2 hours at 25°C after solvent addition. From a microbiological point of view, once reconstituted, the product should be administered immediately.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects while receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects after receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION are hot flushes and inflammation around the injection site, dizziness, weight gain, headache, diarrhoea. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION.

faqs.question: Q: What FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is used for?
faqs.answer: A: FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is used to manage adult patients with advanced hormone dependent prostate cancer.

faqs.question: Q: Can FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, as it may cause harm to the growing baby.

faqs.question: Q: Who should avoid taking FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: FIRMAGON 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you are allergic or hypersensitive to Degarelix or any other ingredients of this medicine.

faqs.question: Q: What is advanced prostate cancer?
faqs.answer: A: Prostate cancer is considered advanced when it breaches the prostate's border. As it advances, the cancer may also spread (metastasize) to other areas of the body. Men with advanced prostate cancer typically start treatment with hormone therapy.

faqs.question: Q: Should I follow any special diet if I have advanced prostate cancer?
faqs.answer: A: Small changes in your diet can lead to healthier living and maintaining overall health. Fruits and vegetables, especially dark, leafy greens, are recommended. Try to reduce fats from red meat and dairy. Instead, choose fish, lean poultry, or plant-based proteins from nuts and beans. Before making changes to your diet, be sure to talk to your doctor.
